registry_entry.title: The market's curve: fitted against hand-picked
registry_entry.question: On the market's own probabilities: a walk-forward fitted LogisticRegression on spread_line alone, against the fixed curve 1 / (1 + exp(-spread / 5.5)) that the live pipeline uses today.
registry_entry.decision_rule: NON-INFERIORITY, margin +0.002 (Mark, 2026-10-01). Switch to the fitted curve if the upper end of the 98.33% interval on (fitted - fixed) log loss is below +0.002. Do not switch if the lower end is above 0. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE: the fixed curve stays and the page says so.
registry_entry.precedence: AMENDED 2026-10-02, before any result (Mark): the two rules above overlap on an interval wholly inside (0, +0.002), measurably worse but by less than the margin. Do-not-switch wins: a measurably worse curve never switches. Labels: lower end above 0 is REJECT; otherwise upper end below the margin is NON-INFERIOR (switch); otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
registry_entry.why_non_inferiority: The reason to switch is like-for-like: the page's live log-loss race compares two fitted models against a curve no data chose. The fitted curve need only be no worse. The margin is about a fifth of H1's confirmation difference (-0.0109, experiments/stage5/results/H1.json).
registry_entry.if_switched: Each prediction stores market_prob_home_fitted beside the existing market_prob_home, and saved picks are never rewritten. Grading and the log-loss race read the fitted value from the week the switch starts. Weeks already locked keep their stored value.
registry_entry.expected: The fitted slope lands near 5.5 and the difference is inside the margin.
